headline: Multi-category demand de-risk volatility; Structural drivers intact

highlights: Q 2F Y2 7 performance : LGEDIA delivered healthy set of results with broad based growth and steady margins.

Segmentally, Home appliances segment (Refrigerators, ACs, washing machine, etc) reported revenue growth of 20.9% YoY to ₹4,772 crore and Home entertainment segment (TVs, audio systems, monitors, etc) reported growth of 17.2% YoY to ₹2,608 crore.
Gross margin reported at 28.9%, declining 52 bps YoY and 265 bps QoQ amid increased cost inflation.
However, EBITDA margin was recorded at 9.5% up 63bps YoY, decline of 322 bps QoQ.
